title: Versioned configuration and capability activation
workflow: Open a new versioned capability change proposal
Attach applicable regulatory and institutional authority evidence
Compute dependencies and effective-date overlap checks
Perform independent legal/finance/security review when appropriate
Activate only approved versions for the approved legal entity and interval
Record rollback/suspension without changing historical applied rules
requirements: A discovered publication does not itself activate a capability
Conflicting effective rules for the same institution/scope must stop activation
All bank-specific settlement and accounting capabilities default to disabled
Maintain immutable historical versions so reports reproduce prior calculations
Require maker-checker for all money-impacting configuration changes
Reject rate or reporting policy changes that would silently modify a posted journal
acceptance_cases: Reproduce old account calculation with original version after an amendment
Deny capability with expired participation evidence
Ensure suspended rail cannot accept new outbound messages
approval_gate: Signed source provenance, approver roles, accepted institution profile and configuration transition tests.
